chapter: Depression gigs, Lil Armstrong, joining Chick Webb
title: Stuff Smith's band and Charlie Green's plan for Lil Armstrong
summary: McRae had worked with Stuff Smith in 1935; Green bought Smith's band for Lil Armstrong while Louis Armstrong was in Europe.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: "I'm thinking on buying Stuff Smath's band." Well I had played with Stuff Smith's band around (inaudible) '35 when they came down from Buffalo. They played at the Lafayette Theater.

And he asked me would I go and do some dates with him in Philly. His piano player was from Philly, so we worked two to three gigs out in Philly, Wilmington, Delaware, and we came back to New York, and
he went on back to Buffalo that winter -- the winter of '35, I think it was.
And I'm in Albany playing at this club. And I get a call from Green, he and say, "I want you to go to Buffalo to join Lil Armstrong."
I say, "Oh, yeah." By that time, Louie Armstrong had been in Europe for about two or three years -- two years. I think he stayed in Europe five years.

It was something that Louie Armstrong got into on the coast. Nobody couldn't understand what it was. I think that Glacier had sent him to Europe. I think it was about (inaudible) or something. They had sent him to Europe until this thing died down.
Yes, I heard there was [cross-talk] something going on. I don't think (inaudible) --
I don't know what it was. But anyway, it was something (inaudible). But Louie Armstrong had to go to Europe.
